values.value: Cancellations up to 14 calendar days before the first day of class will receive a full refund. Cancellation within 14 calendar days of the first day of class will not be refunded. Registration fees cannot be applied to other classes, on-line materials or other services. TTS reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to cancel a course. If TTS cancels a course, payments are refunded in full.
